```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Individual plot export folder
out_dir <- "ploidy_individual_plots_A4_8pt_final_layout"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Requested publication font size
base_pt <- 8
geom_text_pt <- base_pt / ggplot2::.pt

# Final physical size for every panel in the 2-column A4 layout.
# Import into Illustrator at 100% scale so 8 pt remains 8 pt.
panel_width <- 3.5
panel_height <- 2.45

# Export each plot individually. SVG/PDF are vector; TIFF is 600 dpi.
save_individual_plot <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename, ".svg")),
    plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in",
    device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename, ".tiff")),
    plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in",
    dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white"
  )
}
```

# Effective ploidy: fixed ploidy

When A1 is dominant to A2.

```{r fixed-ploidy-functions}
W_avg_f <- function(P2, W1, W2, a){
  W_avg <- (1 - (P2^a))*W1 + (P2^a) * W2
  return(W_avg)
}

P1 <- function(P1, W1, W_avg){
  P1 <- W1 * P1 / W_avg
  return(P1)
}
```

## Lethal

```{r lethal-simulation}
P2_0 <- 0.5
P1_0 <- 1 - P2_0
W1 <- 1
W2 <- 0

t <- 10
data <- data.frame(
  a = NULL,
  generation = NULL,
  P2 = NULL,
  W_avg = NULL
)

for (a in 1:10){
  W_avg <- W_avg_f(P2 = P2_0, W1 = W1, W2 = W2, a = a)
  new_gen <- data.frame(
    a = a,
    generation = 0,
    P2 = P2_0,
    W_avg = W_avg
  )
  data <- rbind(data, new_gen)
  i <- 1
  P1 <- P1_0
  P2 <- P2_0
  for (i in 1:10){
    P1 <- W1 * P1 / W_avg
    P2 <- 1 - P1
    W_avg <- W_avg_f(P2 = P2, W1 = W1, W2 = W2, a = a)
    new_gen <- data.frame(
      a = a,
      generation = i,
      P2 = P2,
      W_avg = W_avg
    )
    data <- rbind(data, new_gen)
    i <- i + 1
  }
}
```

# Beneficial/deleterious selection: dominant versus recessive

```{r four-selection-modes-model}
# A2 is the focal allele. W1 = wild-type fitness; W2 = A2 fitness.
# For a dominant A2 allele, mixed-ploidy infectious units have fitness W2.
# For a recessive A2 allele, mixed-ploidy infectious units have fitness W1.

simulate_fixed_dominance <- function(
    q0 = 0.5,
    W1 = 1,
    W2,
    dominance = c("dominant", "recessive"),
    ploidies = 1:10,
    generations = 10) {

  dominance <- match.arg(dominance)
  out <- data.frame()

  for (c in ploidies) {
    q <- q0

    for (generation in 0:generations) {
      p <- 1 - q
      P_all_A1 <- p^c
      P_all_A2 <- q^c
      P_mixed <- 1 - P_all_A1 - P_all_A2

      W_mixed <- if (dominance == "dominant") W2 else W1
      W_avg <- P_all_A1 * W1 +
        P_all_A2 * W2 +
        P_mixed * W_mixed

      out <- rbind(
        out,
        data.frame(
          Ploidy = c,
          generation = generation,
          P2 = q,
          W_avg = W_avg
        )
      )

      if (generation < generations) {
        # Expected A2 copy fraction after selection.
        # q - q^c is the A2 copy fraction carried in mixed units.
        q <- (W2 * P_all_A2 + W_mixed * (q - P_all_A2)) / W_avg
        q <- max(min(q, 1), 0)
      }
    }
  }

  out
}

selection_scenarios <- data.frame(
  Scenario = c(
    "Beneficial, dominant",
    "Beneficial, recessive",
    "Deleterious, dominant",
    "Deleterious, recessive"
  ),
  W2 = c(1.5, 1.5, 0.2, 0.2),
  Dominance = c("dominant", "recessive", "dominant", "recessive"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

four_mode_data <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(selection_scenarios)), function(i) {
    sim <- simulate_fixed_dominance(
      q0 = 0.5,
      W1 = 1,
      W2 = selection_scenarios$W2[i],
      dominance = selection_scenarios$Dominance[i],
      ploidies = 1:10,
      generations = 10
    )
    sim$Scenario <- selection_scenarios$Scenario[i]
    sim
  })
)

four_mode_data$Ploidy <- factor(four_mode_data$Ploidy, levels = 1:10)
four_mode_data$Scenario <- factor(
  four_mode_data$Scenario,
  levels = selection_scenarios$Scenario
)

make_selection_mode_plot <- function(d, shared_legend = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(
    d,
    aes(x = generation, y = P2, color = Ploidy, group = Ploidy)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = base_pt) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = base_pt),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_pt, family = "Arial"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        colour = "black", size = base_pt, family = "Arial", face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        colour = "black", size = base_pt, family = "Arial", face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1.25),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_pt),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Generation",
      y = "Allele freq.",
      color = "Ploidy"
    )

  if (shared_legend) {
    # One shared ploidy legend for all four selection panels.
    # Place it inside the unused lower half of the beneficial-dominant panel
    # so it does not change the physical plotting-region size.
    p <- p +
      theme(
        legend.position = c(0.58, 0.24),
        legend.justification = c(0.5, 0.5),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.01, "in"),
        legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.01, "in"),
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.20, "in"),
        legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.12, "in")
      ) +
      guides(
        color = guide_legend(
          nrow = 2,
          byrow = TRUE,
          title.position = "top"
        )
      )
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  p
}
```

# Overdominance and underdominance

Here, A1-only infectious units have fitness 1 and A2-only infectious units have
fitness 0.2. Mixed A1/A2 units have fitness 1.1 for overdominance and 0.1 for
underdominance. The starting A2 frequency is 0.5, matching the other fixed-ploidy
selection simulations.

```{r over-under-dominance-model}
simulate_mixed_fitness <- function(
    q0 = 0.5,
    W1 = 1,
    W2 = 0.2,
    W_mixed,
    ploidies = 1:10,
    generations = 10) {

  out <- data.frame()

  for (c in ploidies) {
    q <- q0

    for (generation in 0:generations) {
      p <- 1 - q

      # Probabilities of A1-only, A2-only, and mixed infectious units
      P_all_A1 <- p^c
      P_all_A2 <- q^c
      P_mixed <- 1 - P_all_A1 - P_all_A2

      W_avg <- P_all_A1 * W1 +
        P_all_A2 * W2 +
        P_mixed * W_mixed

      out <- rbind(
        out,
        data.frame(
          Ploidy = c,
          generation = generation,
          P2 = q,
          W_avg = W_avg
        )
      )

      if (generation < generations) {
        # Expected A2 copy fraction after selection.
        # q - q^c is the A2 copy fraction carried in mixed units.
        q <- (
          W2 * P_all_A2 +
          W_mixed * (q - P_all_A2)
        ) / W_avg

        q <- max(min(q, 1), 0)
      }
    }
  }

  out$Ploidy <- factor(out$Ploidy, levels = 1:10)
  out
}

q0_over_under <- 0.5
W1_over_under <- 1
W2_over_under <- 0.2

# Overdominance: mixed units are fitter than both homogeneous states
# W_mixed = 1.1 > W1 = 1 > W2 = 0.2
data_overdominance <- simulate_mixed_fitness(
  q0 = q0_over_under,
  W1 = W1_over_under,
  W2 = W2_over_under,
  W_mixed = 1.1,
  ploidies = 1:10,
  generations = 10
)

# Underdominance: mixed units are less fit than both homogeneous states
# W_mixed = 0.1 < W2 = 0.2 < W1 = 1
data_underdominance <- simulate_mixed_fitness(
  q0 = q0_over_under,
  W1 = W1_over_under,
  W2 = W2_over_under,
  W_mixed = 0.1,
  ploidies = 1:10,
  generations = 10
)
```

# Ploidy = 2: overdominance, dominance, and underdominance

For this comparison, W1 = 1 and W2 = 0.2 are held constant. Only the fitness
of the mixed A1/A2 unit changes: 1.1 for overdominance, 0.2 for A2 dominance,
and 0.1 for underdominance.

```{r ploidy2-over-dominance-under-comparison}
)

print(p_ploidy2_comparison)

  p_ploidy2_comparison,

)
```

# Fixed versus Poisson ploidy

```{r fixed-vs-poisson}
generations <- 10
q0 <- 0.5
p0 <- 1 - q0

W1 <- 1
W2 <- 0

# Compare a fixed-ploidy population with a zero-truncated Poisson (ZTP)
# population having the SAME actual mean ploidy.
c <- 2
target_mean_ploidy <- c

# For C ~ Poisson(lambda) conditioned on C >= 1,
# E[C | C >= 1] = lambda / (1 - exp(-lambda)).
# Solve for the underlying Poisson rate lambda that gives the desired
# zero-truncated mean.
solve_ztp_lambda <- function(target_mean) {
  if (target_mean < 1) {
    stop("The mean of a zero-truncated Poisson distribution must be >= 1.")
  }
  if (abs(target_mean - 1) < 1e-12) {
    return(0)
  }

  objective <- function(lambda) {
    lambda / (-expm1(-lambda)) - target_mean
  }

  upper <- max(10, target_mean * 5)
  while (objective(upper) < 0) {
    upper <- upper * 2
  }

  uniroot(objective, interval = c(1e-12, upper), tol = 1e-12)$root
}

lambda <- solve_ztp_lambda(target_mean_ploidy)
ztp_mean <- if (lambda == 0) 1 else lambda / (-expm1(-lambda))

cat("Fixed ploidy:", c, "\n")
cat("Target ZTP mean ploidy:", target_mean_ploidy, "\n")
cat("Underlying Poisson lambda:", lambda, "\n")
cat("Achieved ZTP mean ploidy:", ztp_mean, "\n")

simulate_fixed <- function(p0, W1, W2, c, generations) {
  p <- numeric(generations + 1)
  p[1] <- p0
  for (t in 1:generations) {
    pt <- p[t]
    p[t + 1] <- (W1 * pt) / (W1 + (W2 - W1) * (1 - pt)^c)
  }
  return(p)
}

simulate_ztp <- function(p0, W1, W2, lambda, generations) {
  p <- numeric(generations + 1)
  p[1] <- p0

  for (t in 1:generations) {
    pt <- p[t]

    # S = E[(1 - p)^C | C >= 1]
    #   = [exp(-lambda * p) - exp(-lambda)] / [1 - exp(-lambda)]
    # Written with expm1() for improved numerical stability.
    if (lambda == 0) {
      S <- 1 - pt
    } else {
      S <- (exp(-lambda * pt) - exp(-lambda)) / (-expm1(-lambda))
    }

    p[t + 1] <- (W1 * pt) / (W1 + (W2 - W1) * S)
  }

  return(p)
}

p_fixed <- simulate_fixed(p0, W1, W2, c, generations)
p_ztp <- simulate_ztp(p0, W1, W2, lambda, generations)

fixed_label <- paste0("Fixed ploidy = ", c)
ztp_label <- paste0("ZTP mean ploidy = ", round(ztp_mean, 3))

data <- data.frame(
  generation = 0:generations,
  Fixed = 1 - p_fixed,
  ZTP = 1 - p_ztp
)

data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Fixed, ZTP),
    names_to = "distribution",
    values_to = "P2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    a = ifelse(distribution == "Fixed", fixed_label, ztp_label),
    a = factor(a, levels = c(fixed_label, ztp_label))
  )

p_fix_poisson <- ggplot(
  data_long,
  aes(x = generation, y = P2, color = a, group = a)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = base_pt) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = base_pt),
    axis.title = element_text(size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = base_pt, family = "Arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
```

# Dominant-negative selection across fixed ploidy

```{r dominant-negative}
generations <- 10
P2_0 <- 0.5
P1_0 <- 1 - P2_0

W1 <- 1
W2 <- 0.2
h <- 0

ploidies <- 1:10

W_avg_DN <- function(P2, W1, W2, c, h = 0) {
  P1 <- 1 - P2
  W_mixed <- h * W1 + (1 - h) * W2
  P_all_A1 <- P1^c
  P_all_A2 <- P2^c
  P_mixed <- 1 - P_all_A1 - P_all_A2

  W_avg <- P_all_A1 * W1 +
    P_all_A2 * W2 +
    P_mixed * W_mixed

  return(W_avg)
}

update_P2_DN <- function(P2, W1, W2, c, h = 0) {
  P1 <- 1 - P2
  W_mixed <- h * W1 + (1 - h) * W2

  P_all_A1 <- P1^c
  P_all_A2 <- P2^c
  P_mixed <- 1 - P_all_A1 - P_all_A2

  W_avg <- P_all_A1 * W1 +
    P_all_A2 * W2 +
    P_mixed * W_mixed

  P2_next <- (W2 * P_all_A2 +
    W_mixed * (P2 - P_all_A2)) / W_avg

  return(P2_next)
}

data <- data.frame(
  Ploidy = integer(),
  generation = integer(),
  P2 = numeric(),
  W_avg = numeric()
)

for (c in ploidies) {
  P2 <- P2_0

  for (generation in 0:generations) {
    W_avg <- W_avg_DN(P2 = P2, W1 = W1, W2 = W2, c = c, h = h)

    data <- rbind(
      data,
      data.frame(
        Ploidy = c,
        generation = generation,
        P2 = P2,
        W_avg = W_avg
      )
    )

    if (generation < generations) {
      P2 <- update_P2_DN(P2 = P2, W1 = W1, W2 = W2, c = c, h = h)
    }
  }
}

data$Ploidy <- factor(data$Ploidy, levels = 1:10)

p_DN <- ggplot(data, aes(
  x = generation,
  y = P2,
  color = Ploidy,
  group = Ploidy
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = base_pt) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = base_pt),
    axis.title = element_text(size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = base_pt, family = "Arial"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = base_pt, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      colour = "black", size = base_pt, family = "Arial", face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      colour = "black", size = base_pt, family = "Arial", face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1.25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = base_pt),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, generations, by = 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Allele freq.",
    color = "Ploidy"
  )

print(p_DN)
save_individual_plot(p_DN, "dominant_negative_W2_0.2_fixed_ploidy", 3.5, 2.45)
```

# Random effective ploidy over generations

```{r random-effective-functions}
W_avg_f_random <- function(P2, W1, W2, c){
  W_avg <- (1 - P2^c) * W1 + P2^c * W2
  return(W_avg)
}

update_P2 <- function(P2, W1, W2, c){
  P1 <- 1 - P2

  W_avg <- W_avg_f_random(P2 = P2, W1 = W1, W2 = W2, c = c)

  P1_next <- W1 * P1 / W_avg
  P2_next <- 1 - P1_next

  P2_next <- max(min(P2_next, 1), 0)

  return(P2_next)
}

simulate_trajectory <- function(P2_0, W1, W2, c_vec){
  T_gen <- length(c_vec)
  P2 <- numeric(T_gen + 1)
  P2[1] <- P2_0

  for(t in seq_len(T_gen)){
    P2[t + 1] <- update_P2(
      P2 = P2[t],
      W1 = W1,
      W2 = W2,
      c = c_vec[t]
    )
  }

  out <- data.frame(
    generation = 0:T_gen,
    P2 = P2,
    ploidy = c(NA, c_vec)
  )

  return(out)
}

simulate_final <- function(P2_0, W1, W2, c_vec){
  traj <- simulate_trajectory(P2_0, W1, W2, c_vec)
  return(tail(traj$P2, 1))
}

find_effective_ploidy <- function(P2_0, W1, W2, c_random){
  T_gen <- length(c_random)

  target_final_P2 <- simulate_final(
    P2_0 = P2_0,
    W1 = W1,
    W2 = W2,
    c_vec = c_random
  )

  objective <- function(c_eff){
    final_P2_eff <- simulate_final(
      P2_0 = P2_0,
      W1 = W1,
      W2 = W2,
      c_vec = rep(c_eff, T_gen)
    )

    return(final_P2_eff - target_final_P2)
  }

  lower <- 1
  upper <- 10

  f_lower <- objective(lower)
  f_upper <- objective(upper)

  if(abs(f_lower) < 1e-12){
    return(lower)
  }

  if(abs(f_upper) < 1e-12){
    return(upper)
  }

  while(f_lower * f_upper > 0 && upper < 1e6){
    upper <- upper * 2
    f_upper <- objective(upper)
  }

  if(f_lower * f_upper > 0){
    stop("Could not find a valid effective ploidy.")
  }

  c_eff <- uniroot(
    objective,
    interval = c(lower, upper),
    tol = 1e-12
  )$root

  return(c_eff)
}
```

```{r random-effective-simulation}
set.seed(123)

T_gen <- 10
P2_0 <- 0.5
W1 <- 1
W2 <- 0

c_random <- sample(1:10, size = T_gen, replace = TRUE)
c_average <- mean(c_random)
c_harmonic <- length(c_random) / sum(1 / c_random)

c_effective <- find_effective_ploidy(
  P2_0 = P2_0,
  W1 = W1,
  W2 = W2,
  c_random = c_random
)

traj_random <- simulate_trajectory(
  P2_0 = P2_0,
  W1 = W1,
  W2 = W2,
  c_vec = c_random
)
traj_random$type <- "Random ploidy"

traj_average <- simulate_trajectory(
  P2_0 = P2_0,
  W1 = W1,
  W2 = W2,
  c_vec = rep(c_average, T_gen)
)
traj_average$type <- paste0("Average ploidy = ", round(c_average, 3))

traj_harmonic <- simulate_trajectory(
  P2_0 = P2_0,
  W1 = W1,
  W2 = W2,
  c_vec = rep(c_harmonic, T_gen)
)
traj_harmonic$type <- paste0("Harmonic mean = ", round(c_harmonic, 3))

traj_effective <- simulate_trajectory(
  P2_0 = P2_0,
  W1 = W1,
  W2 = W2,
  c_vec = rep(c_effective, T_gen)
)
traj_effective$type <- paste0("Effective ploidy = ", round(c_effective, 3))

plot_data <- rbind(
  traj_random,
  traj_average,
  traj_harmonic,
  traj_effective
)

random_label <- "Random ploidy"
average_label <- paste0("Average ploidy = ", round(c_average, 3))
harmonic_label <- paste0("Harmonic mean = ", round(c_harmonic, 3))
effective_label <- paste0("Effective ploidy = ", round(c_effective, 3))

plot_data$a <- factor(
  plot_data$type,
  levels = c(random_label, average_label, harmonic_label, effective_label)
)

cb_colors <- setNames(
  c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#009E73"),
  c(random_label, average_label, harmonic_label, effective_label)
)

line_types <- setNames(
  c("solid", "dashed", "longdash", "dotdash"),
  c(random_label, average_label, harmonic_label, effective_label)
)

ploidy_labels <- data.frame(
  generation = 1:T_gen,
  y = 1.03,
  label = paste0("", c_random)
)
```
